items.note: The net map (JV+RG)x, the bit-case coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 with the side cancellation, and the three-stage track to (-Y,X) with restored auxiliaries all match lines 741-765. Missing: the gate definitions, the neighbour rule, h=100 and the triple indexing. The complex-case coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 is never treated, so only the bit half of the lemma is derived.

Says that a shared invertible frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1} and only edge changes cost anything. This matches 806-817. It is one infer step without the invariant argument or the route formula eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1}.

Correctly states comparable nondegenerate labels, only the central 3->4 edges decreasing by h each, sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L, and L/N = 100/539 and 101/539. The label construction (F^{tensor 3}, triple indicators orthogonal for neighbours, the gate-label table and the residual table) is absent. Only the telescoping step of the proof (1066-1071) is shown.

Has s_b = Wm-N+2L < Wm, the N extra source ranks, and the endpoint difference I_m giving H<-H+D. The assigned matrices (projections P_U, the source matrix -P_{U_a}) and the frames Phi_M are not given. The key proof step, rank(P_V-P_U) = dim V - dim U (1158-1161), is missing.

States one translation kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, and C^{tensor m} on every role after corrections. It does not define the phase frame C_U = H^m diag(i^{q_U}) H^m or give the count s_c = W_c m - 2N + 2L_c. The weight-additivity proof (1232-1314) is only named in a one-line method.

Gives L/N < 1/2, the deficit N-2L > 0 so s < Wm, and tau = 1-2^{-50} with s/W < m^tau. Missing: the relative deficits eta_b and eta_c, the bound eta > 20*2^{-50} with log m < 20 that justifies tau (1331-1338), and sigma for the complex recurrence.

Lists the O(V) elementary operations and the controlled shift and unit scaling modulo q^b. S1.2's claim leaves out the condition that the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time (566), which appears only in the quote. Infer steps only.

Reproduces the cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, edges by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear swap, s calls, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric-sum cases and the O(V) fixed-tape schedule, all as in 1491-1588.

Top rho digits form the row field (R >= W^k), padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^tau), and binary padding to q^e. Matches 1650-1734. Unequal widths (1740-1762) are not covered, but they are not part of the lemma.

Has the change of basis with the residual basis as first columns, one child per direction on a slot, a fixed number of row additions, s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^D = b^D S_D C^D S_D. The identity (C^{-1})^f = (-i)^f Z^f C^f Z^f (1885-1888), which keeps every child a forward call, is missing. The conjugation identity P_M X_v P_M^{-1} = X_{Mv} is also not stated.

Has the eight shifts, the guard interval [10, 2^{K-1}-11], delta_bad = min{1, 80(f-1)2^{-K}}, repair by extraction and stable sort, the omitted top position, and the O(V(L^tau+1)) family cost. The plan never says that T_0 S_0^{-1} fixes the complement of B and permutes B (2107-2114), which is what makes extract-and-reinsert correct. I judged this an essential gap and chose partial conservatively.

Has the individual-kernel leaves, s calls, the row split u = Wg+w with volume V/W, the recurrence with the O((eK)^tau+1) overhead, internal costs O(e^lambda), base-m pieces, and the final lambda' condition. The q_0 row-preprocessing is only named.

Costs divided by V = Tp, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181} = 2 kappa, setup o(V), log factors at most p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff, as in 4810-4995. The table's normalized cost entries are only partly listed (S6.2-S6.5).

errors.says: Eight shifts, each controlled by the other chunk, flip the parity of u exactly when c=1 and restore w.
errors.paper: Each line is controlled by the selected bit c = x_{j_i} of the control chunk x and by the parity of the other integer (w or u). The update targets y or z, with z as restored scratch (2016-2029, 2066-2076). 'Controlled by the other chunk' drops the x control.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. It builds the exchange gadget, frames, label budget, s<Wm and tau, then matrix shears, the interchange recurrence and arbitrary widths, then the complex network, the layer recurrence, transforms, resampling, chirp/CRT/twist, exact recovery and the cost table with min margin 2kappa. It thins out at the label construction and at the projection-rank step rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, which are asserted rather than built. It thins again in the complex side: the phase-frame proof, the inverse-child identity and the guard-depth recurrence are missing.

steps.note: The fixed linear network on three-element subsets, (X,Y) -> (-Y,X) and restoration of all scratch values are present. h=100, the triple-indexed banks with N = binom(h,3)^3, and m = h^3 are never stated, so N and m appear later undefined. The mechanism is there but the quantities are missing; I chose the conservative verdict.
S1.3.3 gives a shared invertible frame commuting with pointwise gates, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the point that only edge changes cost anything.

Nested subspaces of an m-dimensional space attached to gates and terminals; every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels; only the central 3->4 edges decrease, each losing h. F^{tensor 3} itself is not named.

The motivation says an edge needs as many operations as its dimension gain, and S1.3.4.4 says the N negative source projections cost one extra rank. The fact that rank(P_V-P_U) = dim V - dim U for nested U in V, which makes edge cost equal dimension change, is never stated.
sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L, with L from Ic central edges each losing h, and s_b = Wm-N+2L by adding N source ranks.
L_b/N = 100/539 and L_c/N = 101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L > 0 and s < Wm.
The endpoint matrices differ by I_m on every input role, giving the shear H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows. The endpoint matrices themselves are not specified.
A rank-a matrix factors as E_1 Pi E_2, the shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and the number of recursive calls is the sum of edge ranks, s.
Children of volume V/W, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau = 1-2^{-50} with s/W < m^tau, and F_k = O(e^tau). The justification of tau from eta > 20*2^{-50} and log m < 20 is missing.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs most of the central saving. It covers frames, labels with only central losses of h, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b = Wm-N+2L, L/N < 1/2 with s < Wm, the I_m endpoint identity, rank-many interchanges per edge, and the s/W recurrence giving O(e^tau). Two links are weak: the network's defining parameters (h=100, N, m=h^3) and the projection-rank fact that equates an edge's cost with its dimension change. Both are used, but neither is stated.
